key_facts: Presented to the emergency department after a seizure
History of left cerebral ischemic stroke and myocardial infarction 4 months ago
Used synthetic cannabis with resolution of symptoms and neurologic deficits 4 months ago
Used synthetic cannabis just before the seizure
Normal complete blood cell count, chemistry panel, aspirin level, acetaminophen level, alcohol level, and liver function tests
Urine drug screen positive for cannabinoids

raw.rationale: The patient's recent use of synthetic cannabis before the seizure, combined with the history of similar substance use preceding a previous stroke and myocardial infarction, and the presence of diffuse bilateral cortical and subcortical edema on brain imaging, supports this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Post-Stroke Seizure Disorder (Epilepsy)
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of stroke, the seizures occurred immediately after synthetic cannabis use, suggesting a more direct cause.

rejected.label: Reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (RCVS)
rejected.why: There is no clear indication of vasoconstriction or the typical 'thunderclap headache' often associated with RCVS in the provided case facts.
